title: Israel's Vote Leaves No Majority as Arab Parties Win a Record 19 Seats
dek: Neither Netanyahu's bloc nor Eisenkot's reaches 61 seats, Likud calls the result "stolen," and the count of soldiers' and diplomats' ballots starts Thursday.
body: Netanyahu's bloc 53, Eisenkot's 48, Arab parties 19, with 85.6% counted. A majority takes 61; up to 480,000 ballots remain.

panels.label: Likud Says
panels.text: Likud says Arab parties “stole” the election through bribery, threats and forgery, and asks police and the Shin Bet to investigate.

panels.label: The Opposition Says
panels.text: Eisenkot says he will form “a Zionist government” and that Netanyahu should step down; Golan says the opposition should govern with Arab parties.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: Likud speaks of a “stolen” election, the opposition of change; beneath both is who forms the government that runs the Iran war.
